gloss: all at once; simultaneously; in unison

definitions.gloss: all at once; simultaneously; in unison
definitions.explanation: Describes multiple people or things acting at the same time in a coordinated or synchronized manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一斉|いっせい}に⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧。
examples.english: The students all stood up at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合図|あいず}→合図：01675_aizu⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{一斉|いっせい}に⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They all started simultaneously at the signal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一斉|いっせい}に⟦{咲|さ}き→咲く：08150_saku⟧{始|はじ}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花見客|はなみきゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧にぎわう。
examples.english: When the cherry blossoms all start blooming at once, the park bustles with crowds of flower-viewing visitors.

notes:
USAGE:
{一斉|いっせい}に emphasizes that an action happens simultaneously across a group. The noun form ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧ can also be used as a prefix: ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (simultaneous inspection), ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦{送信|そうしん}→送信：17692_soushin⟧ (mass sending/broadcast).
Compared to ⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, which simply means "at the same time," {一斉|いっせい}に implies a larger group acting together and often carries a more dramatic or striking impression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一斉|いっせい}に⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧ (to stand up all at once)
- {一斉|いっせい}に⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ (to begin simultaneously)
- {一斉|いっせい}に⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧ (to bloom all at once)
- ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧{検挙|けんきょ} (mass arrest)
